papers.title: ReSum: Synergizing LLM Reasoning and Summarization with Reinforcement Learning
papers.what: Trains a model under verifiable rewards to summarize its own reasoning mid-trace and continue from the summary, cutting rollout length 18.6 percent while raising accuracy 4 percent.

papers.title: Beyond Entropy: Learning from Token-Level Distributional Deviations for LLM Reasoning
papers.what: Updates only the ~10 percent of tokens with the most distinctive logit distributions (by Jensen-Shannon divergence), giving an average pass@4 gain of 4.58 percent over GRPO without a hand-tuned entropy term.

papers.title: Process-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Theorem Proving via Lean
papers.what: Uses the Lean proof assistant as a dense, type-checked process reward (per-tactic soundness and first failing step) instead of a single binary outcome reward, beating outcome-only RLVR on MiniF2F and ProofNet.

papers.title: MetaForge: A Self-Evolving Multimodal Agent that Retrieves, Adapts, and Forges Tools On Demand
papers.what: A multimodal agent that retrieves, adapts, or writes new tools on demand and retains them for reuse, so its tool set grows across tasks instead of resetting each time.
